title: SEO continuation verified locally; production migration awaits approval
summary: 390 HTTP checks across 34 products, 58 regressions, production build and responsive dashboard workflows passed. SEO storage remains absent in production.

changes.detail: Stale editor forms retain their opened version; explicit reload prevents silent overwrites after refresh or bulk generation. Pagination stays within filtered result bounds.
Category sitemap works with the actual legacy schema without updated_at, preserving retryable failure behavior for other errors.
Read-only verification supports Node 26, all-product checks, duplicate detection and meaningful failure exit codes; browser regression covers manual drafts and stale refresh.
Append-only continuation reports and documentation of actual verification, rollout prerequisites and limitations. No existing reports or application features removed.
